supporting_observations.claim: The supplied evidence records a large transfer from FILE-ORC-01 to the explicit proxy at 13:49:51 UTC: 640,000,532 bytes sent and 39,150 bytes received over HTTP to port 8080.

The transfer's size and outbound-heavy direction are compatible with the inventory's description of Keystone backup uploads, but the available record does not identify Keystone as the destination or the process that sent the data.
The large-transfer record is timestamped about four minutes after the alert's approximate 13:46 UTC time; the supplied evidence does not show a large transfer at exactly 13:46 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied connection record identifies FILE-ORC-01, the proxy, port, byte counts, and timing, but does not include the requested URL, hostname, or ultimate external destination.
The supplied evidence does not link the large transfer to a process, executable, service account, or scheduled job.
The records do not establish whether the proxy connection was authorized Keystone backup traffic or another upload.
claims_not_established: That the large transfer went to keystone-backup.net or was generated by the approved Keystone agent.
That the transfer contained authorized backup data rather than other files.
That the transfer was malicious or that data was exfiltrated to an unapproved destination.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-ORC-01 access logs for the connection at 13:49:51 UTC, including the requested host, URL, and any CONNECT or upstream destination details.
Correlate the transfer with FILE-ORC-01 process and service logs, including Keystone agent logs, scheduled-job history, and process-to-network telemetry.
Confirm the expected backup job schedule and whether this upload's destination, contents, and volume match the approved Keystone backup.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: tess.hart initiated RDP from WS-THART-01 to FILE-ORC-01 and logged on interactively; inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-SBYRNE-01. This is outside the alerted transfer. (T270-00010, T270-00017, T270-00021)
Separate ticket: FILE-ORC-01 connected to PROXY-ORC-01 on SSH port 22, an unapproved remote-access service; the evidence does not link this connection to the large HTTP transfer. (T270-00450)
Separate ticket: FILE-ORC-01 recorded a failed network logon for the disabled account svc_mgmt from DC-ORC-01. (T270-00447)
